set.body: Default bilateral normalized half-canvas slots remain too far apart on wide short canvases. Add explicit renderer-neutral viewport group fitting, with Fill preserving literal coordinates and Contain preserving a declared group aspect ratio. Compiler may choose compact 2:1 bilateral packing. JavaFX and Three rendering and Three picking must resolve the same fitted slots at the current canvas size; layout dirty detection must include fitting policy. Do not alter mesh/world coordinates or camera distance. Shared JVM/JS tests should independently verify wide/narrow positions, equal pixel scale, ordering, offsets and invalid inputs; native FX and Three backend tests verify adoption. Camera-fit utilization and paired lateral/medial directions remain separate.
set.title: Support compact aspect-preserving surface viewport groups
